versus  STATE & ANR.

Through: Mr.Rahul Tyagi, A  Mr.Sudeep Raj Sai  Mr.Aashish Chojar  Ramkishan, PS Sag  Mr.Manohar Nagar,
 with R2 in person

CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YOGESH KHANNA
This petition is filed for quashing of FIR No.810/2022 under Sections 498A/34 IPC registered at PS Sagarpur, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
1. The marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 was solemnized on 08.12.2019 as per Hindu rites and ceremonies.
However, due to marital discord both the husband and wife started residing separately.

On 07.11.2020 the respondent no.2 filed a complaint under Section 12 DV Act against the petitioner no.1 herein and on 05.12.2022 the present FIR was registered at the instance of the respondent no.2.
2.
On 13.03.2023 the respondent no.2 withdrew her complaint under Section 12 DV Act.
Due to intervention of family members and friends, a settlement has been arrived at between the parties on 11.04.2023.
In lieu of said settlement the respondent no.2 agreed to got dissolve her marriage by filing first motion of divorce within two weeks from today and thereafter second motion of divorce as per law.

3. The respondent no.2 is present in the Court and has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer and she has no objection in case the FIR is quashed as the matter is settled between them and she has no claim left of whatsoever nature against the petitioners herein.

The affidavits of Vinay Kumar & Ors vs State & Anr on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141641205/
1 parties are on record.

entities.text: Vinay Kumar & Ors vs State & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned ASC for the State also has no objection in case the petition is allowed.
4. In view of the above there is no impediment in quashing the present FIR as the matter is settled between the parties and it would never entail in conviction of the petitioners herein.
2. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.810/2022 under Sections 498A/34 IPC registered at PS Sagarpur, Delhi
and the proceedings emanating therefrom stands quashed.

Pending application(s), if any, also stands disposed of.
YOGESH KHANNA, J.
